title: quickUnlock.set
description: Seal the primary's keys under a PIN in the service's memory and turn the PIN's switch on (the manager app only). Endpoint: admin; direction: a2s; phase A. Unknown members are ignored by the reader (protocol.md section 8).

pin.description: Sealed under the connection's bundle key like a bundle, the associated data naming the message and the field (section 6.4).
